summary: Find, evaluate, tailor for, and track job applications.

Usage: jobs [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Find, evaluate, tailor for, and track job applications

help.ready:
Usage: jobs ready [OPTIONS]

  Open strong and possible roles; score is optional.

Options:
  --limit <int range>        [default: 10; 1<=x<=50]
  --min-score <float range>  Explicit scored-only filter  [0<=x<=5]
  --human                    Plain-text rendering
  --remote                   Use hosts.production_api
  --help                     Show this message and exit.
help.show:
Usage: jobs show [OPTIONS] {posting_id}

  Posting detail: description, evaluation report, skill gap, legitimacy.

Arguments:

Options:
  --description / --no-description

  --human                         Plain-text rendering
  --remote                        Use hosts.production_api

usage.when: pick the next job worth acting on; start of any job-search working session
usage.why: strong and possible open postings, including unscored roles, with pending screening shown separately
precautions: read-only; postings already applied to are excluded, not ranked low

usage.when: read one posting in full before evaluating, tailoring, or deciding to skip it
usage.why: returns the job description together with its evaluation, skill gap and legitimacy flags
precautions: read-only; description can be long — use --no-description when only the verdict matters

usage.when: pull new postings from the tracked boards before triaging
usage.why: one run fetches, filters, de-duplicates and persists; counters say what was dropped and why
precautions: a full sweep takes minutes — narrow with --source or --company, or use --background
network-bound; writes new postings but never modifies existing applications

usage.when: triage the postings a scan left in `new` so the scored queues stop coming back empty
usage.why: one cheap call per posting sorts it into shortlisted or discarded; nothing else moves a posting out of `new`
precautions: spends one Agent Hub call per posting and runs serially — 50 takes several minutes
bounded by JOBINATOR_SCREEN_DAILY_CAP when --limit is omitted
the nightly worker already screens at 07:30 UTC; use this to work down a backlog

usage.when: score a posting for fit before spending a tailoring run on it
usage.why: persists the full report, subscores, legitimacy signal and skill gap against the posting
precautions: spends an Agent Hub call and takes tens of seconds; free-tier quota resets midnight Pacific
re-running records another evaluation rather than replacing the last one

usage.when: produce the resume and cover letter for a posting you intend to submit
usage.why: writes both documents against this job description and stores them as versioned artifacts on the application
precautions: spends Agent Hub calls and takes up to a minute per document
a blocked fact check exits 1 with the invented claims listed — fix the CV facts or regenerate, never hand-edit past it
generating opens an application record if the posting has none

usage.when: you have submitted an application and it needs to be on the record
usage.why: opens the application, dates it, and moves the posting out of the discovery queue
precautions: records state only — nothing is submitted to an employer from here
idempotent per posting: a second call re-uses the existing application
use --no-submit to open an application you have not sent yet
examples: st jobs apply 41 -m 'referred by a former colleague'

usage.when: an application moved — a reply arrived, an interview was scheduled, a rejection landed
usage.why: writes a timeline transition as well as the new status, so funnel analytics stay truthful
precautions: records state only; nothing is sent to an employer
statuses: evaluated applied responded interview offer rejected discarded skip hired
examples: st jobs status 9 interview -m 'panel scheduled for the 12th'

usage.when: review what is in flight, or find the application id for a status change
precautions: read-only

usage.when: check which applications are owed a nudge
precautions: read-only; sending is manual — mark one sent from the UI after you send it

usage.when: an interview is scheduled and the candidate needs a brief for it
usage.why: reads the posting and the evaluation, then matches the story bank against what this interview will ask
precautions: --write spends an Agent Hub call and takes about a minute; without it this only reads existing briefs
a story the bank does not hold is reported as a suggestion, never as prepared material

usage.when: report on the search: how many applications sit at each stage, and what the board holds
precautions: read-only; counts are current state, not a time series

usage.when: before writing anything on the candidate's behalf — targets, comp, authorization, allowed metrics
usage.why: the same candidate block the screener and tailor agents are given, so an agent-written draft cannot drift from theirs
precautions: read-only; cv_facts.allow_metrics is the only set of numbers permitted in generated documents

usage.when: read the exact editable candidate requirements and their revision
usage.why: prepare a specific profile change without overwriting unrelated fields
precautions: private candidate data; read-only

usage.when: save owner-requested target roles, pay, location, or other candidate requirements
usage.why: updates the canonical profile and refreshes role matching
precautions: read profile-edit first; changes replace only named fields; stale revisions are rejected

usage.when: inspect base CV versions before drafting or restoring one
usage.why: preserves the reviewed CV history
precautions: private candidate data; JSON includes full CV text

usage.when: activate a revised base CV after its exact text and facts were reviewed with the owner
usage.why: creates a version and refreshes the candidate's role matching
precautions: replaces the active CV; never set --verified before the owner reviews the exact draft

usage.when: answer a shaped question about the board — remote full-time at small companies, anything within 50 miles, channel vendors only
usage.why: `ready` ranks the whole queue by score; this is the same list narrowed by work mode, employment type, company size, segment and distance
precautions: read-only
--employee-band, --segment and --max-distance only match companies that have been researched; an unresearched company is unknown, not excluded on merit
--max-distance drops remote roles, which have no distance to measure — pass --remote remote instead
examples: st jobs search --remote remote --remote hybrid --employment full_time --employee-band startup_1_50 --employee-band small_51_200

usage.when: start a weekly job-search session
usage.why: one snapshot of ready and pending roles, scans, failures, decisions, and events
precautions: read-only; no employer contact or notifications

usage.when: read the reviewed CV before a posting assessment or document draft
usage.why: returns the active CV, fact constraints, and revision identifiers
precautions: private candidate data; read-only

usage.when: save a sourced human or TUI posting assessment
usage.why: binds verdict and unknowns to the CV and posting revisions
precautions: evidence URLs and matching revisions are required

usage.when: record owner interest and sourced company culture findings
usage.why: keeps the owner's rating separate from inferred company fit
precautions: a positive or conflicting culture claim needs cited evidence

usage.when: record a verified official board or unsupported employer
usage.why: monitored boards enter Jobinator's collector with their official link evidence
precautions: monitored entries require an installed source and official evidence

usage.when: save a dated, sourced professional event
usage.why: feeds the upcoming events calendar with known cost or explicit unknown
precautions: no registration or notification is sent

usage.when: review upcoming sourced events
precautions: read-only; past events are excluded

usage.when: record a like, dislike, or mixed reaction to a role, company, or event
usage.why: creates a durable pending reaction for explicit review
precautions: nothing is sent to employers or organizers

usage.when: review pending and clarified owner reactions
precautions: read-only private feedback

usage.when: atomically claim one pending reaction for review
precautions: revision mismatch returns a conflict

usage.when: record a sourced preference effect or clarification question
precautions: only soft preferences apply; exclusions are proposals

usage.when: record the owner's answer to a clarification question
precautions: revision mismatch returns a conflict

usage.when: undo an applied soft preference after owner correction
precautions: preserves original reaction and reason

usage.when: save direct-employer, official careers, Florida, and ownership evidence
precautions: unresolved employers remain research-only

usage.when: check an employer's current monitoring gate
precautions: read-only

usage.when: record a private owner exception to PE-controlled MSP exclusion
precautions: named exclusions and non-employers still block monitoring

usage.when: check current preparation blockers and provenance before applying
precautions: read-only; does not submit an application

usage.when: save a sourced official JD and preparation notes
precautions: requires current CV, profile, and posting revisions; does not submit

usage.when: record the owner's company and culture priorities for future search sessions
usage.why: keeps explicit owner values separate from inferred company fit
precautions: does not contact employers or change the reviewed CV

usage.when: the owner does not want a company in the search
usage.why: stops monitoring, hides its current postings, and blocks future imports for this profile
precautions: preserves global postings and other profiles' choices

usage.when: review monitored, failed, unsupported, and unexplored employers
usage.why: includes latest board health and missed daily scans
precautions: read-only

usage.when: import a posting found on an unsupported official board with st web
usage.why: stores a sourced URL and description in Jobinator for the normal review flow
precautions: the input URL must be the actual posting source

usage.when: link an imported posting to a researched employer after confirming identity
usage.why: resolves company identity while leaving the employer qualification gate in place
precautions: confirm the posting names this employer before associating

usage.when: save a TUI-written application document
usage.why: passes it through the CV fact check and stores a versioned artifact
precautions: a draft only; nothing is submitted to an employer

usage.when: judge an employer before reading its postings — size, ownership, offices, whether it sells through the channel
usage.why: the firmographics the posting filters depend on, plus which companies are still unresearched
precautions: read-only
a null field on a researched company means it was looked for and could not be sourced; `not researched` means nobody has looked
